description: Get Use of Force data from the FBI. Covers incidents where law enforcement use of force resulted in death, serious injury, or firearm discharge. Available at federal (all federal agencies) or national (all participating agencies) level. Use scope='federal' for federal agencies, 'national' for all agencies participation data.

scope.description: 'federal' = federal UoF by year, 'national' = national UoF participation by year

name: fbi_use_of_force
